integrity: Analytical uniqueness, convex inverse and Jacobian are proved; numerical tests are finite cross-checks, not infinite certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a known unit-contrast nonempty ball; known Gaussian normalization; indexed Hermite coefficients. Local, not uniform, stability; general-mask reconstruction and unordered-spectrum determination are not claimed. Geometric folklore historical priority is uncertain.
title: Minimal Hermite moment tomography of displaced Gaussian localization balls
